sources.title: Fla. Admin. Code r. 68A-24.002 (Furbearers; effective July 1, 2026)
sources.notes: Official rule text; archived locally in hidden_files/season-research/.

license_summary.trapping_license: A furbearer/trapping license is required to set traps or snares and for commercial sale of furbearers; a hunting license is required for take by methods other than trapping.
license_summary.bobcat_otter_tagging: A CITES tag is required when a bobcat or otter pelt is sold or transported across state lines; hunters may possess one untagged untanned pelt of each; untagged pelts are prohibited April 1 – November 30; trappers have no possession limit. (FWC contact for CITES tags: 850-488-5878.)
license_summary.timezone_note: The Florida Panhandle (west of the Apalachicola River) observes Central Time; the rest of Florida observes Eastern Time. Season dates shown are statewide calendar dates.
